value.literal: Zhang Yi was ashamed and had nothing to show for his efforts.

value.zh: 留魏四歲而魏襄王卒，哀王立。
value.en: He tarried in Wei for four years until King Xiang of Wei passed away, and King Ai took the throne.
value.literal: He remained in Wei four years until King Xiang of Wei died and King Ai ascended.

value.zh: 張儀復說哀王，哀王不聽。
value.en: Zhang Yi once more urged King Ai, but he paid no heed.
value.literal: Zhang Yi again persuaded King Ai, but he wouldn't listen.

value.zh: 於是張儀陰令秦伐魏。
value.en: Thus, Zhang Yi covertly commanded Qin to assault Wei.
value.literal: Zhang Yi secretly ordered Qin to attack Wei.

value.zh: 魏與秦戰，敗。
value.en: Wei battled Qin and suffered defeat.
value.literal: Wei fought Qin and was defeated.

value.zh: 明年，齊又來敗魏於觀津。
value.en: The following year, Qi once more vanquished Wei at Guanjin.
value.literal: The next year, Qi again defeated Wei at Guanjin.

value.zh: 秦復欲攻魏，先敗韓申差軍，斬首八萬，諸侯震恐。
value.en: Qin sought to strike Wei once more. First they routed Han's Shen Chai army, taking eighty thousand heads. The feudal lords trembled in fear.
value.literal: Qin wanted to attack Wei again. First they defeated Han's Shen Chai army, beheading eighty thousand. The feudal lords were terrified.

value.zh: 而張儀復說魏王曰：「魏地方不至千里，卒不過三十萬。
value.en: Zhang Yi once more addressed the King of Wei: "Wei's domain measures barely a thousand li square, its soldiers numbering no more than three hundred thousand.
value.literal: Zhang Yi again persuaded the King of Wei: 'Wei's territory is not even a thousand li square, with troops not exceeding three hundred thousand.

value.zh: 地四平，諸侯四通輻湊，無名山大川之限。
value.en: The terrain lies flat in all directions, with highways from the feudal lords meeting like spokes at a wheel's hub, lacking famed mountains or mighty rivers for defense.
value.literal: The land is flat all around, with roads from the feudal lords converging like spokes to a hub, without famous mountains or great rivers as barriers.

value.zh: 從鄭至梁二百餘里，車馳人走，不待力而至。
value.en: From Zheng to Liang spans barely two hundred li—chariots gallop and men sprint, reaching their destination without strain.
value.literal: From Zheng to Liang is only two hundred li—chariots race and men run, arriving without effort.

value.zh: 梁南與楚境，西與韓境，北與趙境，東與齊境，卒戍四方，守亭鄣者不下十萬。
value.en: Liang abuts Chu southward, Han westward, Zhao northward, Qi eastward. Soldiers garrison the frontiers on all sides, with no less than ten thousand men defending the watchtowers and ramparts.
value.literal: Liang borders Chu to the south, Han to the west, Zhao to the north, Qi to the east. Garrisons man the borders in all directions, with no fewer than ten thousand troops guarding the watchtowers and barriers.

value.zh: 梁之地勢，固戰場也。
value.en: Given Liang's strategic location, it is inherently a battleground.
value.literal: Given Liang's geographical position, it is naturally a battlefield.

value.zh: 梁南與楚而不與齊，則齊攻其東；
value.en: Should Liang unite with Chu but not Qi, Qi will assault from the east;
value.literal: If Liang allies with Chu but not Qi, Qi will attack from the east;

value.zh: 東與齊而不與趙，則趙攻其北；
value.en: Should it ally with Qi but not Zhao, Zhao will strike from the north;
value.literal: If allied with Qi but not Zhao, Zhao will attack from the north;

value.zh: 不合於韓，則韓攻其西；
value.en: If not allied with Han, Han will invade from the west;
value.literal: If not united with Han, Han will attack from the west;

value.zh: 不親於楚，則楚攻其南：此所謂四分五裂之道也。
value.en: If Wei is not close to Chu, Chu will attack from the south. This is what they call the path to being split apart.
value.literal: If Wei is not close to Chu, Chu will attack from the south. This is what is called the path to being split apart.

value.zh: 為大王計，莫如事秦。
value.en: In planning for Your Majesty, nothing surpasses serving Qin.
value.literal: For Your Majesty's sake, nothing is better than serving Qin.

value.zh: 事秦則楚、韓必不敢動；
value.en: By serving Qin, Chu, and Han will assuredly not dare stir;
value.literal: Serving Qin means Chu and Han will certainly not dare move;

value.zh: 無楚、韓之患，則大王高枕而臥，國必無憂矣。
value.en: Free from the threats of Chu and Han, Your Majesty can rest easy, and the state will know no anxiety.
value.literal: No Chu Han calamity, then great wang high pillow lie, state certainly no worry.

value.zh: 哀王於是乃倍從約而因儀請成於秦。
value.en: King Ai therefore betrayed the alliance and through Zhang Yi petitioned Qin for peace.
value.literal: King Ai then abandoned the alliance and through Zhang Yi sought peace with Qin.

value.zh: 張儀歸，復相秦。
value.en: Zhang Yi returned home and resumed his premiership in Qin.
value.literal: Zhang Yi returned and again became prime minister of Qin.

value.zh: 三歲而魏復背秦為從。
value.en: Three years passed and Wei once more turned its back on Qin to form alliances.
value.literal: Three years later, Wei again abandoned Qin for alliances.

value.zh: 秦攻魏，取曲沃。
value.en: Qin assaulted Wei and captured Quwo.
value.literal: Qin attacked Wei and took Quwo.

value.zh: 明年，魏復事秦。
value.en: The following year, Wei once more submitted to Qin.
value.literal: The next year, Wei again served Qin.

value.zh: 秦欲伐齊，齊楚從親，於是張儀往相楚。
value.en: Qin desired to campaign against Qi. Since Qi and Chu were confederated, Zhang Yi proceeded to Chu to serve as its premier.
value.literal: Qin wanted to attack Qi. Qi and Chu were allied, so Zhang Yi went to become prime minister of Chu.

value.zh: 楚懷王聞張儀來，虛上舍而自館之。
value.en: King Huai of Chu learned of Zhang Yi's arrival and emptied the finest chambers to accommodate him himself.
value.literal: King Huai of Chu heard Zhang Yi was coming and prepared the finest guest quarters to house him personally.

value.zh: 曰：「此僻陋之國，子何以教之？」
value.en: He said, "This is an out-of-the-way rustic land—what wisdom do you bring to enlighten it?"
value.literal: He said, 'This is a remote and backward country—what teachings do you bring?'

value.zh: 儀說楚王曰：「大王誠能聽臣，閉關絕約於齊，臣請獻商於之地六百里，使秦女得為大王箕帚之妾，秦楚娶婦嫁女，長為兄弟之國。
value.en: Zhang Yi addressed the King of Chu: "If Your Majesty will truly heed my counsel, close your passes and sever your agreements with Qi. I shall present the territory of Shangyu, six hundred li in extent, so that Qin women may serve as Your Majesty's humble attendants. Qin and Chu will exchange brides and become brother states forever.
value.literal: Zhang Yi persuaded the King of Chu: 'If Your Majesty truly listens to me, close your passes and break your agreements with Qi. I will present the territory of Shangyu, six hundred li in extent, so that Qin women may serve as Your Majesty's humble attendants. Qin and Chu will exchange brides and become brother states forever.

value.zh: 此北弱齊而西益秦也，計無便此者。」
value.en: This diminishes Qi northward while enriching Qin westward—no strategy could prove more advantageous."
value.literal: This weakens Qi to the north while benefiting Qin to the west—no plan could be better.'

value.zh: 楚王大說而許之。
value.en: The King of Chu was immensely delighted and consented.
value.literal: The King of Chu was greatly pleased and agreed.

value.zh: 群臣皆賀，陳軫獨弔之。
value.en: All the courtiers offered felicitations, but Chen Zhen alone expressed condolences.
value.literal: All the ministers congratulated him, but Chen Zhen alone mourned.

value.zh: 楚王怒曰：「寡人不興師發兵得六百里地，群臣皆賀，子獨弔，何也？」
value.en: The King of Chu grew furious: "I acquired six hundred li of territory without mobilizing armies or dispatching troops. All my ministers rejoice, yet you alone lament—what is the reason?"
value.literal: The King of Chu was angry: 'I obtained six hundred li of land without raising troops or sending armies. All ministers congratulate me, yet you alone mourn—why?'

value.zh: 陳軫對曰：「不然，以臣觀之，商於之地不可得而齊秦合，齊秦合則患必至矣。」
value.en: Chen Zhen responded: "Not at all. In your minister's view, the territory of Shangyu cannot be obtained, and Qi and Qin will unite. Once Qi and Qin unite, disaster will certainly come."
value.literal: Chen Zhen replied: 'Not so. In my view, the land of Shangyu cannot be obtained, and Qi and Qin will unite; once Qi and Qin unite, disaster will certainly come.'

value.zh: 楚王曰：「有說乎？」
value.en: The King of Chu asked, "Do you have something to say?"
value.literal: The King of Chu said, 'Do you have an explanation?'

value.zh: 陳軫對曰：「夫秦之所以重楚者，以其有齊也。
value.en: Chen Zhen responded: "Qin's esteem for Chu stems from Chu's alliance with Qi.
value.literal: Chen Zhen replied: 'Qin's reason for valuing Chu is because Chu has Qi as an ally.

value.zh: 今閉關絕約於齊，則楚孤。
value.en: Now sealing the passes and severing ties with Qi isolates Chu.
value.literal: Now closing borders and breaking with Qi leaves Chu isolated.

value.zh: 秦奚貪夫孤國，而與之商於之地六百里？
value.en: Why would Qin desire a solitary kingdom and bestow upon it six hundred li of Shangyu territory?
value.literal: Why would Qin covet an isolated state and give it six hundred li of Shangyu land?

value.zh: 張儀至秦，必負王，是北絕齊交，西生患於秦也，而兩國之兵必俱至。
value.en: Zhang Yi will return to Qin and assuredly deceive Your Majesty—this severs alliances with Qi northward and provokes enmity with Qin westward. The armies of both realms will surely advance in concert.
value.literal: Zhang Yi will return to Qin and certainly betray Your Majesty—this cuts off Qi relations to the north and creates trouble with Qin to the west. The troops of both countries will certainly attack together.

value.zh: 善為王計者，不若陰合而陽絕於齊，使人隨張儀。
value.en: A wise strategy for Your Majesty would be to maintain covert concord while overtly rupturing with Qi, dispatching an envoy to accompany Zhang Yi.
value.literal: A good plan for Your Majesty would be to secretly unite while openly breaking with Qi, sending someone to follow Zhang Yi.

value.zh: 茍與吾地，絕齊未晚也；
value.en: Should they cede the territory, severing with Qi will not be untimely;
value.literal: If they give us the land, breaking with Qi is not too late;

value.zh: 不與吾地，陰合謀計也。」
value.en: Should they withhold the territory, we preserve the clandestine partnership."
value.literal: If they don't give us the land, we maintain the secret alliance.'

value.zh: 楚王曰：「願陳子閉口毋復言，以待寡人得地。」
value.en: The King of Chu declared, "I would have you seal your lips and cease speaking, awaiting my acquisition of the territory."
value.literal: The King of Chu said, 'I wish you would shut your mouth and stop speaking, waiting for me to get the land.'

value.zh: 乃以相印授張儀，厚賂之。
value.en: He bestowed the premier's seal upon Zhang Yi and lavished gifts upon him.
value.literal: He gave the prime minister's seal to Zhang Yi and richly bribed him.

value.zh: 於是遂閉關絕約於齊，使一將軍隨張儀。
value.en: Chu accordingly sealed its passes and renounced relations with Qi, dispatching a single commander to escort Zhang Yi.
value.literal: Chu then closed its borders and broke relations with Qi, sending one general to follow Zhang Yi.

value.zh: 張儀至秦，詳失綏墮車，不朝三月。
value.en: Zhang Yi arrived in Qin, feigning the loss of his reins and tumbling from his chariot, absenting himself from court for three months.
value.literal: Zhang Yi returned to Qin, pretending to lose his reins and fall from his chariot, not appearing at court for three months.

value.zh: 楚王聞之，曰：「儀以寡人絕齊未甚邪？」
value.en: The King of Chu learned of this and exclaimed, "Does Zhang Yi believe my severance from Qi insufficient?"
value.literal: The King of Chu heard this and said, 'Is Zhang Yi thinking my break with Qi is not complete enough?'

value.zh: 乃使勇士至宋，借宋之符，北罵齊王。
value.en: He dispatched valiant warriors to Song, borrowing Song's insignia, to journey north and revile the King of Qi.
value.literal: He sent brave warriors to Song, borrowing Song's credentials, to go north and curse the King of Qi.

value.zh: 齊王大怒，折節而下秦。
value.en: The King of Qi raged furiously and bent his pride to yield to Qin.
value.literal: The King of Qi was furious and humbled himself to submit to Qin.

value.zh: 秦齊之交合，張儀乃朝，謂楚使者曰：「臣有奉邑六里，願以獻大王左右。」
value.en: With Qin and Qi united in alliance, Zhang Yi appeared at court and addressed the Chu envoy: "Your servant possesses a fiefdom of six li—I wish to present it to Your Majesty's retainers."
value.literal: With Qin and Qi allied, Zhang Yi appeared at court and told the Chu envoy: 'I have a fief of six li— I wish to present it to Your Majesty's attendants.'

value.zh: 楚使者曰：「臣受令於王，以商於之地六百里，不聞六里。」
value.en: The Chu envoy replied, "Your servant received the king's command for six hundred li of Shangyu territory, not six li."
value.literal: The Chu envoy said, 'I received orders from the king for six hundred li of Shangyu land, not six li.'

value.zh: 還報楚王，楚王大怒，發兵而攻秦。
value.en: He returned and informed the King of Chu, who erupted in rage and mobilized forces to assault Qin.
value.literal: He returned and reported to the King of Chu, who was furious and sent troops to attack Qin.

value.zh: 陳軫曰：「軫可發口言乎？
value.en: Chen Zhen inquired, "May your servant now open his mouth to speak?
value.literal: Chen Zhen said, 'May I now speak?

value.zh: 攻之不如割地反以賂秦，與之并兵而攻齊，是我出地於秦，取償於齊也，王國尚可存。」
value.en: Assaulting Qin proves inferior to surrendering territory to appease them, combining our armies to strike at Qi—this surrenders land to Qin but exacts recompense from Qi. Your Majesty's realm can yet endure."
value.literal: Attacking is not as good as ceding land to bribe Qin, uniting troops to attack Qi—this gives land to Qin but takes compensation from Qi. Your Majesty's kingdom can still survive.'

value.zh: 楚王不聽，卒發兵而使將軍屈丐擊秦。
value.en: The King of Chu paid no heed and ultimately dispatched forces under General Qu Gai to strike at Qin.
value.literal: The King of Chu wouldn't listen and sent troops with General Qu Gai to attack Qin.

value.zh: 秦齊共攻楚，斬首八萬，殺屈丐，遂取丹陽、漢中之地。
value.en: Qin and Qi jointly assaulted Chu, decapitating eighty thousand, slaying Qu Gai, and seizing the lands of Danyang and Hanzhong.
value.literal: Qin and Qi together attacked Chu, beheading eighty thousand, killing Qu Gai, and taking Danyang and Hanzhong.

value.zh: 楚又復益發兵而襲秦，至藍田，大戰，楚大敗，於是楚割兩城以與秦平。
value.en: Chu once more amassed additional forces to ambush Qin, advancing to Lantian. In a monumental clash, Chu suffered catastrophic defeat. Chu consequently relinquished two cities to reconcile with Qin.
value.literal: Chu again raised more troops to attack Qin, reaching Lantian. In a great battle, Chu was badly defeated. Chu then ceded two cities to make peace with Qin.

value.zh: 秦要楚欲得黔中地，欲以武關外易之。
value.en: Qin coerced Chu into yielding Qianzhong territory, proposing to barter the lands beyond Wuguan.
value.literal: Qin pressed Chu for Qianzhong land, offering to exchange Wuguan.

value.zh: 楚王曰：「不願易地，願得張儀而獻黔中地。」
value.en: The King of Chu declared, "I desire no land exchange—I want Zhang Yi and will surrender Qianzhong territory."
value.literal: The King of Chu said, 'I don't want to exchange land—I want Zhang Yi and will cede Qianzhong.'

value.zh: 秦王欲遣之，口弗忍言。
value.en: The King of Qin desired to dispatch him but could not bring himself to utter the words.
value.literal: The King of Qin wanted to send him but couldn't bear to say it.

value.zh: 張儀乃請行。
value.en: Zhang Yi then requested to proceed.
value.literal: Zhang Yi volunteered to go.

value.zh: 惠王曰：「彼楚王怒子之負以商於之地，是且甘心於子。」
value.en: King Hui cautioned, "The King of Chu is angry that you deceived him over the territory of Shangyu; he will surely vent his anger on you."
value.literal: King Hui said, 'The King of Chu is angry that you deceived him over the territory of Shangyu; he will surely vent his anger on you.'

value.zh: 張儀曰：「秦彊楚弱，臣善靳尚，尚得事楚夫人鄭袖，袖所言皆從。
value.en: Zhang Yi replied, "Qin is mighty while Chu is feeble. Your servant enjoys friendship with Jin Shang, who attends Lady Zheng Xiu of Chu. Whatever she commands is obeyed.
value.literal: Zhang Yi said, 'Qin is strong and Chu weak. I am close to Jin Shang, who serves Lady Zheng Xiu. Whatever she says is followed.

value.zh: 且臣奉王之節使楚，楚何敢加誅。
value.en: Your servant bears Your Majesty's insignia on mission to Chu. How would Chu dare punish me?
value.literal: Moreover, I carry Your Majesty's credentials to Chu—how dare Chu execute me.

value.zh: 假令誅臣而為秦得黔中之地，臣之上願。」
value.en: Even should they put me to death and thereby secure Qianzhong for Qin, that would fulfill my supreme desire."
value.literal: Even if they execute me and Qin gets Qianzhong, that would fulfill my greatest wish.'

value.zh: 遂使楚。
value.en: He proceeded to Chu.
value.literal: He went to Chu.

value.zh: 楚懷王至則囚張儀，將殺之。
value.en: The King of Chu imprisoned Zhang Yi upon his arrival and prepared to execute him.
value.literal: The King of Chu imprisoned Zhang Yi and prepared to kill him.

value.zh: 靳尚謂鄭袖曰：「子亦知子之賤於王乎？」
value.en: Jin Shang said to Zheng Xiu: "Are you aware of your lowly status in the king's eyes?"
value.literal: Jin Shang said to Zheng Xiu: 'Do you know how lowly you are to the king?'

value.zh: 鄭袖曰：「何也？」
value.en: Zheng Xiu asked, "How so?"
value.literal: Zheng Xiu said, 'Why?'

value.zh: 靳尚曰：「秦王甚愛張儀而不欲出之，今將以上庸之地六縣賂楚，美人聘楚，以宮中善歌謳者為媵。
value.en: Jin Shang said: "The King of Qin greatly values Zhang Yi and does not want to surrender him. Now he plans to offer six counties of Shangyong territory as a bribe to Chu and send beautiful women as brides, accompanied by palace singers as attendants.
value.literal: Jin Shang said: 'The King of Qin greatly values Zhang Yi and does not want to send him away. Now he plans to offer six counties of Shangyong territory as a bribe to Chu and send beautiful women as brides, accompanied by palace singers as attendants.

value.zh: 楚王重地尊秦，秦女必貴而夫人斥矣。
value.en: The King of Chu prizes the territory and reveres Qin—Qin maidens will surely be exalted while you, my lady, will be discarded.
value.literal: The King of Chu values the land and respects Qin—Qin women will certainly be honored while you, madam, will be cast aside.

value.zh: 不若為言而出之。」
value.en: Better to intercede on his behalf and secure his release."
value.literal: Better to speak on his behalf to save him.'

value.zh: 於是鄭袖日夜言懷王曰：「人臣各為其主用。
value.en: Zheng Xiu then spoke to King Huai day and night: "Ministers each serve their own lord.
value.literal: Zheng Xiu then spoke to King Huai day and night: 'Ministers each serve their own lord.

value.zh: 今地未入秦，秦使張儀來，至重王。
value.en: The territory has not yet passed to Qin, yet Qin dispatches Zhang Yi, demonstrating utmost reverence for the king.
value.literal: Now the land has not yet gone to Qin, yet Qin sends Zhang Yi, showing great respect for the king.

value.zh: 王未有禮而殺張儀，秦必大怒攻楚。
value.en: The king shows no graciousness yet seeks to execute Zhang Yi—Qin will surely rage and assault Chu.
value.literal: The king has shown no courtesy but wants to kill Zhang Yi—Qin will certainly be furious and attack Chu.

value.zh: 妾請子母俱遷江南，毋為秦所魚肉也。」
value.en: I implore you and my son to relocate south of the Yangtze, lest we become Qin's fish and flesh."
value.literal: I beg you and my son to move to south of the Yangtze, lest we become Qin's fish and meat.'

value.zh: 懷王後悔，赦張儀，厚禮之如故。
value.en: King Huai came to regret his actions, pardoned Zhang Yi, and bestowed upon him the same lavish treatment as before.
value.literal: King Huai regretted it, pardoned Zhang Yi, and treated him with the same generous hospitality.

value.zh: 張儀既出，未去，聞蘇秦死，乃說楚王曰：「秦地半天下，兵敵四國，被險帶河，四塞以為固。
value.en: Zhang Yi had left but had not yet gone far when he learned of Su Qin's death. He then addressed the King of Chu: "Qin controls half the world, with troops able to rival four states, protected by dangerous terrain and the Yellow River, and secured by four natural barriers.
value.literal: Zhang Yi had left but had not yet gone far when he heard Su Qin had died. He then persuaded the King of Chu: 'Qin controls half the world, with troops able to rival four states, protected by dangerous terrain and the Yellow River, and secured by four natural barriers.

value.zh: 虎賁之士百餘萬，車千乘，騎萬匹，積粟如丘山。
value.en: Boasting over a million fierce warriors, a thousand chariots, ten thousand cavalry, with grain stockpiled like mountain ranges.
value.literal: With fierce warriors over a million, a thousand chariots, ten thousand cavalry, grain piled like mountains.

value.zh: 法令既明，士卒安難樂死，主明以嚴，將智以武，雖無出甲，席卷常山之險，必折天下之脊，天下有後服者先亡。
value.en: Laws are lucid, soldiers embrace peril and welcome death with joy. The sovereign is enlightened yet stern, commanders wise and valiant. Even without deploying armor, Qin can sweep away the perils of Mount Chang and snap the world's spine. Those who yield belatedly shall perish first.
value.literal: Laws are clear, soldiers face hardship and death with joy. The ruler is enlightened and strict, generals intelligent and brave. Even without mobilizing troops, Qin can roll up the dangers of Mount Chang and break the world's backbone. Those who submit late will perish first.

value.zh: 且夫為從者，無以異於驅群羊而攻猛虎，虎之與羊不格明矣。
value.en: Forming confederations is no different from herding sheep to attack a ferocious tiger. It is obvious that sheep cannot contend with a tiger.
value.literal: Moreover, forming alliances is no different from driving a flock of sheep to attack a fierce tiger—the tiger and sheep cannot fight, that's clear.

value.zh: 今王不與猛虎而與群羊，臣竊以為大王之計過也。
value.en: Now Your Majesty allies not with the ferocious tiger but with the herd of sheep—I humbly deem Your Majesty's strategy misguided.
value.literal: Now Your Majesty does not ally with the fierce tiger but with the flock of sheep—I secretly think Your Majesty's plan is wrong.

value.zh: 今秦與楚接境壤界，固形親之國也。
value.en: Now Qin and Chu share borders and territories—they are naturally states that should be close.
value.literal: Using one deceitful Su Qin to try to manage the world and unite the feudal lords—the impossibility of success is clear.

value.zh: 大王誠能聽臣，臣請使秦太子入質於楚，楚太子入質於秦，請以秦女為大王箕帚之妾，效萬室之都以為湯沐之邑，長為昆弟之國，終身無相攻伐。
value.en: If Your Majesty will truly heed my counsel, I shall arrange for the Qin crown prince to serve as hostage in Chu, and the Chu crown prince to serve as hostage in Qin. I shall present Qin maidens as Your Majesty's humble attendants, and cede a city of ten thousand households as Your bathing fief. Let us be fraternal realms forever, never assaulting one another for all our lives.
value.literal: If Your Majesty truly listens to me, I will have the Qin crown prince become hostage in Chu, the Chu crown prince become hostage in Qin. I will make Qin women become Your Majesty's broom-wielding concubines, present a city of ten thousand households as a bathing town. Let us be brother states forever, never attacking each other.

value.zh: 臣以為計無便於此者。」
value.en: I deem no strategy more beneficial than this."
value.literal: I consider no plan more advantageous than this.'

value.zh: 於是楚王已得張儀而重出黔中地與秦，欲許之。
value.en: Thus, the King of Chu, having already secured Zhang Yi, was willing to part with Qianzhong territory to Qin and desired to agree to the terms.
value.literal: Then Chu Wang already obtain Zhang Yi heavy send Qian Zhong land to Qin, wished permit him.

value.zh: 屈原曰：「前大王見欺於張儀，張儀至，臣以為大王烹之；
value.en: Qu Yuan said: "The former king was deceived by Zhang Yi. Now that Zhang Yi has come, I believe Your Majesty should boil him alive.
value.literal: Qu Yuan said: "Former great wang see cheat Zhang Yi, Zhang Yi arrive, subject think great wang boil him;

value.zh: 今縱弗忍殺之，又聽其邪說，不可。」
value.en: Now if you cannot bear to kill him, at least do not listen to his crooked words—it would be unacceptable."
value.literal: Now release not endure kill him, moreover listen his crooked words, unacceptable."

value.zh: 懷王曰：「許儀而得黔中，美利也。
value.en: King Huai said, "If agreeing to Zhang Yi lets us obtain Qianzhong, that is an excellent profit.
value.literal: King Huai said: "To agree to Zhang Yi and obtain Qianzhong is a fine profit.

value.zh: 後而倍之，不可。」
value.en: To betray him afterward would be unacceptable."
value.literal: After double it, unacceptable."

value.zh: 故卒許張儀，與秦親。
value.en: Therefore, they ultimately agreed to Zhang Yi's terms and formed intimate relations with Qin.
value.literal: Therefore, they finally agreed to Zhang Yi's terms and formed close ties with Qin.

value.zh: 張儀去楚，因遂之韓，說韓王曰：「韓地險惡山居，五穀所生，非菽而麥，民之食大抵［飯］菽［飯］藿羹。
value.en: Zhang Yi left Chu and proceeded to Han, where he addressed the King of Han: "Han territory is perilous and harsh, suited for mountain dwelling. Of the five grains, it produces mainly beans and wheat; the people's food consists mostly of beans and bean-leaf soup.
value.literal: Zhang Yi left Chu and proceeded to Han, where he advised the King of Han: "Han territory is perilous and harsh, suited for mountain dwelling. Of the five grains, it produces mainly beans and wheat; the people's food consists mostly of beans and bean-leaf soup.

value.zh: 一歲不收，民不饜糟糠。
value.en: If a single year brings no harvest, the people cannot even eat their fill of chaff and bran.
value.literal: If one year brings no harvest, the people cannot even eat their fill of chaff and bran.

value.zh: 地不過九百里，無二歲之食。
value.en: Its territory does not exceed nine hundred li, with no provisions for two years.
value.literal: Land not exceed nine hundred li, no two years food.

value.zh: 料大王之卒，悉之不過三十萬，而廝徒負養在其中矣。
value.en: Estimating Your Majesty's troops, all told they do not exceed three hundred thousand, yet servants and baggage carriers are counted among them.
value.literal: Estimate great wang troops, all not exceed thirty thousand, yet servants burden support in midst.

value.zh: 除守徼亭鄣塞，見卒不過二十萬而已矣。
value.en: Excluding those guarding border towers and barriers, your actual fighting troops do not exceed two hundred thousand at most.
value.literal: Except guard border towers barriers, see troops not exceed twenty thousand only.

value.zh: 秦帶甲百餘萬，車千乘，騎萬匹，虎賁之士跿跔科頭貫頤奮戟者，至不可勝計。
value.en: Qin fields over a million armored warriors, a thousand chariots, ten thousand cavalry mounts, and tiger-brave soldiers who squat and kneel, bareheaded, piercing chins and brandishing halberds, too many to count.
value.literal: Qin armored hundred thousand, chariots thousand, cavalry ten thousand horses, tiger brave soldiers bend kneel bare head pierce chin wave halberd, to cannot count.

value.zh: 秦馬之良，戎兵之眾，探前趹後蹄閒三尋騰者，不可勝數。
value.en: Qin's horses are superb, its barbarian troops numerous; those that probe forward and kick backward with hooves spanning three zhang in their leaps are too many to count.
value.literal: Qin horses excellent, Rong troops multitude, probe front kick rear hoof between three zhang leap, cannot count.

value.zh: 山東之士被甲蒙胄以會戰，秦人捐甲徒裼以趨敵，左挈人頭，右挾生虜。
value.en: Eastern warriors don armor and helmets to meet battle, while Qin soldiers cast off their armor and charge the enemy bare-chested, clutching severed heads in their left hands and dragging living captives with their right.
value.literal: Shandong scholars don armor cover helmets meet battle, Qin people cast armor bare advance enemy, left grasp people heads, right hold living captives.

value.zh: 夫秦卒與山東之卒，猶孟賁之與怯夫；
value.en: Qin's soldiers compared to eastern troops are like Meng Ben to a coward;
value.literal: Qin troops with Shandong troops, like Meng Ben with coward;

value.zh: 以重力相壓，猶烏獲之與嬰兒。
value.en: pressing with overwhelming force, like Wu Huo against an infant.
value.literal: With heavy strength press, like Wu Huo with infant.

value.zh: 夫戰孟賁、烏獲之士以攻不服之弱國，無異垂千鈞之重於鳥卵之上，必無幸矣。
value.en: To deploy soldiers like Meng Ben and Wu Huo against unsubmissive weak states is like suspending a thousand-jun weight above a bird's egg. Surely there will be no survivors.
value.literal: Battle Meng Ben Wu Huo soldiers attack not submit weak states, no different hang thousand jun weight on bird egg above, certainly no lucky.

value.zh: 故為大王計，莫如為秦。
value.en: Therefore, in planning for Your Majesty, nothing surpasses serving Qin.
value.literal: Therefore, for great wang planning, none better serve Qin.

value.zh: 秦之所欲莫如弱楚，而能弱楚者如韓。
value.en: Qin's greatest desire is to weaken Chu, and none can weaken Chu like Han.
value.literal: Qin desire weaken none like Chu, yet can weaken Chu like Han.

value.zh: 非以韓能彊於楚也，其地勢然也。
value.en: Not because Han is stronger than Chu, but because the terrain makes it so.
value.literal: Not because Han can strong Chu, its land position so.

value.zh: 今王西面而事秦以攻楚，秦王必喜。
value.en: If Your Majesty now faces west to serve Qin and attack Chu, the King of Qin will certainly be pleased.
value.literal: Now wang west face serve Qin attack Chu, Qin Wang certainly happy.

value.zh: 夫攻楚以利其地，轉禍而說秦，計無便於此者。」
value.en: If Han attacks Chu, it can profit from Chu territory, turn disaster aside, and please Qin. No plan is more advantageous than this."
value.literal: By attacking Chu, Han will profit from its territory, turn calamity around, and please Qin; no plan is more advantageous than this."

value.zh: 韓王聽儀計。
value.en: The King of Han followed Zhang Yi's plan.
value.literal: Han Wang listen Yi plan.

value.zh: 張儀歸報，秦惠王封儀五邑，號曰武信君。
value.en: Zhang Yi returned and reported. King Hui of Qin enfeoffed him with five cities and styled him Lord Wuxin.
value.literal: Zhang Yi return report, Qin Hui Wang enfeoff Yi five cities, number Wu Xin Jun.

value.zh: 使張儀東說齊湣王曰：「天下彊國無過齊者，大臣父兄殷眾富樂。
value.en: He sent Zhang Yi east to persuade King Min of Qi: "Among the world's strong states, none surpasses Qi. Your ministers, fathers, and elder brothers are numerous, wealthy, and content.
value.literal: Make Zhang Yi east advise Qi Min Wang: "World strong states none exceed Qi, ministers fathers elder brothers numerous rich joyful.

value.zh: 然而為大王計者，皆為一時之說，不顧百世之利。
value.en: Yet those who plan for Your Majesty all speak of momentary gains, disregarding benefits for a hundred generations.
value.literal: Yet for great wang planning, all momentary speech, not consider hundred generations profit.

value.zh: 從人說大王者，必曰『齊西有彊趙，南有韓與梁。
value.en: Confederation advocates persuading Your Majesty will certainly say: Qi has mighty Zhao to the west, Han and Wei to the south.
value.literal: Alliance advocates persuading Your Majesty will certainly say: "Qi has strong Zhao to the west, Han and Wei to the south.

value.zh: 齊，負海之國也，地廣民眾，兵彊士勇，雖有百秦，將無柰齊何』。
value.en: Qi is a coastal state with vast territory, teeming populace, powerful armies, and valiant soldiers. Even with a hundred Qins, what could they do against Qi?
value.literal: Qi is a maritime state with broad territory, numerous people, strong troops, and brave soldiers. Even with a hundred Qins, what could they do to Qi?

value.zh: 大王賢其說而不計其實。
value.en: Your Majesty admires their rhetoric but does not calculate the reality.

value.en: Confederation advocates form cliques and collude, none failing to deem alliance acceptable.

value.zh: 臣聞之，齊與魯三戰而魯三勝，國以危亡隨其後，雖有戰勝之名，而有亡國之實。
value.en: I have heard it said that Qi fought Lu three times and Lu prevailed three times, yet danger and extinction followed for the state. Though bearing the name of victory, it possessed the reality of a perished state.
value.literal: I have heard that Qi fought Lu three times and Lu won three times, yet the state faced danger and extinction afterward. Though having the name of victory, it had the reality of a perished state.

value.zh: 是何也？
value.en: Why is this?
value.literal: Why?

value.zh: 齊大而魯小也。
value.en: Qi is great while Lu is small.
value.literal: Qi is large and Lu is small.

value.zh: 今秦之與齊也，猶齊之與魯也。
value.en: Now Qin's relation to Qi is like Qi's relation to Lu.
value.literal: Now Qin compared to Qi is like Qi compared to Lu.

value.zh: 秦趙戰於河漳之上，再戰而趙再勝秦；

value.literal: Qin and Zhao fought at the He and Zhang rivers—two battles and Zhao won Qin twice;

value.zh: 戰於番吾之下，再戰又勝秦。
value.en: battled below Fanwu—in two more engagements again prevailed against Qin.
value.literal: fought at Fanwu below—two battles and again won Qin.

value.zh: 四戰之後，趙之亡卒數十萬，邯鄲僅存，雖有戰勝之名而國已破矣。
value.en: After four campaigns, Zhao's fallen soldiers numbered several hundred thousand. Handan barely endured. Though bearing victory's reputation, the kingdom was already shattered.
value.literal: After four battles, Zhao's perished troops numbered several hundred thousand. Handan barely survived. Though having victory's name, the state was already broken.

value.zh: 是何也？
value.en: How is this?
value.literal: Why?

value.en: Qin is mighty while Zhao is feeble.
value.literal: Qin is strong and Zhao is weak.

value.en: Now Qin and Chu wed their daughters and take brides, becoming fraternal realms.

value.en: The kingdom attacked for a single day—even desiring to serve Qin afterward will prove unattainable.

My humble state feared and trembled, repaired armor, sharpened weapons, prepared chariots and cavalry, practiced riding and shooting, worked fields and stored grain, guarded within the four borders, anxiously dwelling in fear, not daring to stir—only awaiting Your Majesty's intention to chastise.

value.literal: When my father abandoned his ministers in death, I was young and newly responsible for the ancestral sacrifices. In my heart I secretly doubted, believing that joining the alliance and not serving Qin was not the state's long-term benefit.

value.literal: Drinking with the King of Dai, secretly told the cook: "When wine is abundant and joy high, advance hot soup, turn the ladle to strike him."

value.en: Thus, when wine flowed copiously and revelry peaked, hot soup was presented. The cook advanced to pour, then turned the ladle to strike the King of Dai, killing him, his brains splattering the earth.
